payload.criteria:
The vital few (definition | requirement id | weight):
1. Scannability - the QR encodes to the correct, reliably-scannable matrix | R3 | 0.30.
2. Install-simplicity - one-click install preserved; a vendored dep must be small + clean, a hand-roll adds code but no dep | R4, se.adr-install-over-zerodep | 0.25.
3. Secrecy-safe - encodes locally, no external call; a vendored lib must not phone home | R2 | 0.20.
4. Least-code / maintainable - fewest lines and moving parts to carry | maintainability | 0.15.
5. Time-to-build - how fast to a correct working encoder | affordability | 0.10.
